saved mask comes from C6, which loads the C5 cache (/tmp/d.npz) and builds per-day-of-year pools from contiguous ±5-day index windows over 1992–2002, restricted to sea cells. It takes the hazen 90th percentile, fills day 60, applies a wrapped 31-day smoothing, and compares the 92 target days against the smoothed threshold to find runs and join gaps. Target days of year 153–244 draw on smoothed raw days 138–259, so the baseline values that reach the mask are 12 May to 20 September of each baseline year; climatology is unused."}
